milestone.title: mp autopilot lifecycle transaction + commit/finding attribution

intent.outcome: Autopilot closes implementation and remediation through an explicit transactional lifecycle protocol with auditable commit and finding attribution.

problem.description: The herdr runs exposed completion commands that overwrote evidence, generic review evidence, and unclear `fixed_in` ownership. The cycle engine needs a separate closure module so state transitions and git/review attribution are testable without expanding the scheduler.

in_scope: Exact runner-complete, review-claim, finding, remediation, reviews-pass, and lifecycle-complete command sequence.
Implementation commits map to steps or documented groups; remediation uses one actual fix commit per finding and stores it in fixed_in.
Precondition failure and partial-command failure leave lifecycle, reviews, and evidence in a reconcilable state.
out_of_scope: Cycle scheduling and decision policy, owned by M213.
Reviewer process isolation and crash recovery, owned by follow-up milestones.

acceptance_criteria.description: A fixture executes runner completion, independent review claim, finding add, remediation, finding resolution with actual fixed_in commit, reviews pass, and lifecycle complete; each state and evidence revision is asserted.
Commit policy rejects missing or fabricated fixed_in hashes, ambiguous grouped remediation commits, and lifecycle metadata commits that overwrite per-AC evidence.
A failure injected at every lifecycle command boundary is restart-safe: completed writes remain auditable, incomplete transitions do not fabricate success, and rerun is idempotent.

design_decisions.choice: Compose existing milestone/review commands behind revision-checked idempotency keys; never mutate milestone or reviews files directly from autopilot.
design_decisions.rationale: This preserves canonical validation/audit behavior and makes partial closure recoverable.

work_packages.name: Lifecycle closure transaction
work_packages.goal: Implement exact lifecycle/review command sequencing with idempotent failure recovery.
work_packages.rollback: Disable automatic closure and leave sessions AwaitingUser with evidence intact.

steps.action: Implement typed lifecycle closure protocol over existing milestone and reviews commands, including revision checks and idempotency.
steps.done_when: AC-01 passes through lifecycle complete with independent reviewer attribution.

steps.action: Implement commit and fixed_in attribution policy, preserving AC evidence across lifecycle metadata commits.
steps.done_when: AC-02 rejects fabricated, missing, and ambiguous commit attribution.

steps.action: Add command-boundary failure injection and idempotent rerun/reconciliation fixtures.
steps.done_when: AC-03 passes for every injected boundary.
